title: Quick Hits — National "firsts"**: 8 cheetahs from Botswana joining Kuno (3rd translocation batch, Project Cheetah, population now 53); V.O. Chidambaranar Port — India's 1st Digital Twin port platform; India's 1st hydrogen trainset (ICF Chennai, Jind-Sonipat trial); APSEZ's Port of Refuge — Dighi (west) + Gopalpur (east), India's 1st; India's 1st riverine lighthouses on Brahmaputra (₹84 crore, solar); India's 1st Integrated OTEC plant (Kavaratti) — world first-mover ahead of Japan/US; 25 MT GI-tagged Assam Joha Rice exported to UK/Italy; Odisha tops mining economy (~14% GVA); Madurai declared International Airport; Biopharma SHAKTI proposed (₹10,000 crore/5 yrs); National Dental Commission replaces Dental Council of India (in force 19 March 2026); Energy Statistics India 2026 (33rd edn) — renewable potential 47,04,043 MW.
